outlets.name: Time Out — Madison
outlets.credible: International city-guide brand; bylined Madison restaurant (15 best) and things-to-do lists.

outlets.name: Brava Magazine
outlets.credible: Madison's women's lifestyle magazine (since 2005); bylined food features incl. Kevin Revolinski.

outlets.name: Madison365
outlets.credible: Madison nonprofit newsroom covering communities of color; reports restaurant openings/closings.

outlets.name: The Daily Cardinal (UW–Madison)
outlets.credible: UW–Madison's independent student daily since 1892; long-running restaurant reviews. Corroborating only.

outlets.name: WMTV 15 News
outlets.credible: Madison NBC affiliate newsroom; reports closings.

outlets.name: James Beard Foundation — editorial ('Ask a Chef')
outlets.credible: JBF editorial content (chef interviews). Counts as ONE ordinary source, never lone authority (run-protocol key hygiene).

outlets.name: PBS Wisconsin
outlets.credible: Statewide public broadcaster; produced features on Madison restaurants.

outlets.name: Visit The USA (Brand USA)
outlets.credible: The US national destination-marketing organization; Madison destination page names the Capitol, Olbrich, Memorial Union Terrace and Arboretum.

outlets.name: Atlas Obscura
outlets.credible: Notable travel site for unusual places; per-place pages with coordinates.

outlets.name: Frank Lloyd Wright Foundation
outlets.credible: The Wright Foundation (owns Taliesin West, archives); authoritative on Wright buildings. Not a lone authority.

outlets.name: Wisconsin Historical Society
outlets.credible: State historical society; National/State Register property records. Editorial weight, not lone.

outlets.name: SAH Archipedia (Society of Architectural Historians)
outlets.credible: Peer-reviewed architectural encyclopedia of US buildings.

outlets.name: UNESCO World Heritage Centre
outlets.credible: World Heritage inscription (Taliesin, 2019, 'The 20th-Century Architecture of Frank Lloyd Wright'). Lone authority.

outlets.name: National Park Service (NHL / National Natural Landmark)
outlets.credible: NPS designations only (National Historic Landmarks, National Natural Landmarks). Lone authority for those sites.

outlets.name: Visit Middleton (Middleton Tourism Commission)
outlets.credible: Official municipal tourism office for Middleton.

outlets.name: showcaves.com
outlets.credible: Long-running international show-cave directory (Jochen Duckeck). Corroborating only.
